fields.company_about: Adarsh ID Cards is a leading ID card manufacturing and services company serving schools, organizations and enterprises across India.
fields.short_description: Designed and built CardFlow - a production SaaS platform for ID card data management, automated workflows, and card generation. Serving 1,000+ real users with multi-client cross-platform architecture.
fields.detailed_description:
Led full-cycle engineering of CardFlow, a production-grade ID card management SaaS platform built from the ground up for Adarsh ID Cards.

Key Responsibilities:
- Architected the entire system: Django/DRF backend, React frontend, PostgreSQL, Celery + Redis background processing, and deployment infrastructure
- Built a centralized data management engine supporting structured card records, bulk operations, duplicate detection, photo fields, and configurable field types
- Designed and implemented a multi-state workflow system: Pending -> Verified -> Approved -> Processed -> Downloaded
- Developed RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) with granular permission scopes for administrators, operators, and clients
- Built a card generation engine outputting production-ready ID card layouts at scale
- Integrated cross-platform clients (Web + Desktop via Electron) against the same REST API backend
- Deployed and operated the system in production, supporting 1,000+ real users and tens of thousands of card records
- Managed PostgreSQL schema design, Redis caching, Celery task queues, Nginx, and Gunicorn process management

fields.title: CardFlow
fields.description: Production ID card management platform built for schools and organizations, covering data management, automated workflows, card generation and cross-platform operations.
fields.documentation:
Enterprise Production SaaS

CardFlow — Enterprise ID Card Management & Automated Generation Platform

CardFlow is a centralized production software platform built to help schools and organizations manage large volumes of ID-card data, streamline verification and approval workflows, process student information, and generate downloadable high-DPI ID-card outputs through a centralized system. Designed and developed from the ground up by me end-to-end.

Live Links: Live Website (cardflow.in) Play Store App GitHub Repository

Production Scale & Impact

1,000+
Production Users
Actively used by real organizations
136K+
ID Cards Managed
Processed student & staff records
86K+
Cards Downloaded
High-DPI print-ready outputs
435+
Play Store Installs
Android mobile app users

Core Data Workflow Lifecycle

The system is built around an explicit workflow-based state model rather than treating ID cards as isolated files:

1. Pending
2. Verified
3. Approved
4. Processed
5. Downloaded

Problem Solved vs. CardFlow Solution

Traditional Bottlenecks
  • Manual spreadsheets and disconnected image folders
  • Duplicate records and disorganized student photographs
  • Repetitive manual data verification and status tracking
  • Multiple stakeholders editing conflicting datasets
  • Slow, error-prone manual approval and export processes
Centralized CardFlow Solution
  • Centralized data pipelines with instant duplicate detection
  • Automated photo cropping, finishing, and matching
  • Granular RBAC for Admins, Schools, and Operators
  • Asynchronous background rendering via Celery & Redis
  • One-click batch generation of print-ready thermal card files

9 Core Engineering Components

1. Data Management Engine

Flexible table-oriented schema supporting configurable fields, multi-type values, unique constraints, duplicate detection, and high-performance bulk operations.

2. Authentication & RBAC

Role-based architecture (Owner, Admin, Assistant, Operator) strictly governing permissions for view, create, edit, verify, approve, download, and user administration.

3. Workflow Management

Explicit lifecycle transitions making it possible to track progress across large datasets with complete administrative visibility.

4. Audit Logging Layer

Records who performed an action, what operation occurred, affected record, timestamp, and field-level diffs for full organizational compliance.

5. Import & Export Engine

Imports CSV, XLSX, and ZIP photo datasets with automatic schema validation; exports XLSX, CSV, print-ready PDF, and DOCX outputs.

6. Image & Photo Pipeline

Dedicated processing for student & relationship photographs, missing photo indicators, and auto-cropping to prevent misprinted physical cards.

7. Background Processing

Celery + Redis workers offload heavy image manipulation, PDF compilation, and large imports from the synchronous HTTP request thread.

8. REST API Architecture

Django REST Framework API-first backend providing centralized endpoints for auth, cards, workflows, and batch operations across all clients.

9. Cross-Platform Ecosystem

Shared backend logic serving React Web, Electron Desktop, and React Native Android clients with identical business rules.

Background Processing Architecture (Celery + Redis)

User Request ──► Django REST API ──► Create Background Job ──► Redis Queue │ ▼ User Receives Result ◄── Update Database ◄── Process Task ◄── Celery Worker

Production Deployment & Infrastructure

[Web Clients / Apps] ──► Internet ──► Nginx Reverse Proxy ──► Gunicorn ──► Django / DRF ──► PostgreSQL DB │ ▼ Redis Queue ──► Celery Workers ──► High-DPI Output Generation

Technology Stack Breakdown

LayerTechnologies
FrontendReact, Modern CSS3, HTML5
BackendPython, Django, Django REST Framework
DatabasePostgreSQL (ACID, Relational, Indexing)
Background Jobs & CacheCelery, Redis Message Broker
Desktop & MobileElectron (Desktop), React Native (Android)
Deployment & InfrastructureDocker, Nginx, Gunicorn, Linux VPS
Version ControlGit, GitHub

Engineering Evolution

Initial Data Management ──► Authentication ──► Role-Based Access ──► Workflow Management │ ▼ Production Operations ◄── Cross-Platform Clients ◄── Background Processing ◄── Bulk Import/Export

5 Real Engineering Challenges Overcome

1. Large Dataset Operations

Users needed to search, filter, sort, verify, and approve 136K+ card records without UI lag. Solved via database indexing, query optimization, and bulk SQL updates.

2. Multi-User Operations & RBAC

Prevented unauthorized operations across organizations with an explicit permission matrix enforced at both API serializers and service layers.

3. Long-Running Operations

Moving multi-thousand record exports and photo calibrations into Celery background workers decoupled user actions from HTTP response timeouts.

4. Source Data Quality & Deduplication

Implemented checksum duplicate detection and pre-generation validation checks to eliminate missing photographs and corrupt rows before printing.

5. Real Production Reliability

Refined error handling, graceful fallback for malformed spreadsheets, and seamless rolling updates on production Linux servers.

Key Architectural Decisions

Why Django & DRF?

Provided a mature ORM, built-in security protections, robust admin interface, and standardized REST API endpoints for multiple client platforms.

Why PostgreSQL?

Strict ACID guarantees, relational integrity for multi-tenant data, fast B-tree indexing on search fields, and battle-tested production reliability.

Why Redis & Celery?

Eliminated web request blocking during heavy image finishing, PDF compilation, and bulk imports by queuing tasks in background workers.

Why API-First Architecture?

Allowed React Web, Electron Desktop, and Android to share identical business rules, validation schemas, and database transactions.

Software Engineer Ownership Summary

End-to-End Responsibility

Responsible for CardFlow from concept to production: architecture, database design, backend APIs, frontend, authentication, background workers, deployment, and ongoing optimization. Handling 1,000+ users, 136K+ records, 86K+ downloads, and 435+ Android installs in real production.

fields.title: VidyaMaxx
fields.description: AI-integrated school management platform bringing academics, administration, communication and school operations into one system.
fields.documentation:
MVP / Pilot Testing

VidyaMaxx — AI-First Unified School Management Platform

VidyaMaxx is an AI-first school management platform designed to bring academic management, administration, communication, student information, and day-to-day school operations into a unified digital ecosystem across web and desktop.

Platform & Links: GitHub Repository Web: Available Desktop: Available Android / iOS: Planned

Current Status & Pilot Validation

Partner School Demonstrations

Demonstrated through live development environments to selected partner schools, allowing educators and administrators to validate workflows, usability, and operational throughput before production rollout.

Current Phase Focus

Validating multi-role permissions, grading schemas, automated timetabling constraints, parent-teacher communication loops, and predictive student progress tracking.

The Problem: Fragmented Legacy Systems

Distributed School Bottlenecks
  • Disconnected databases for attendance, grades, and fees
  • Duplicated manual data entry across disparate departments
  • Zero unified visibility for principals and administrators
  • Isolated communication channels causing parent friction
  • Lack of predictive intelligence for struggling students
Connected VidyaMaxx Operating System
  • Unified relational data model with shared business rules
  • Single source of truth for student & staff lifecycles
  • Real-time administrative dashboards and reporting
  • AI-assisted analytics predicting academic needs early
  • Cross-platform access for Web, Desktop, and Mobile

Product Vision & Connected Data Architecture

VidyaMaxx Platform │ ┌───────────────┼────────────────┐ ↓ ↓ ↓ Academics Administration Communication │ │ │ └───────────────┼────────────────┘ ↓ Unified School Data ↓ AI Capabilities (Predictive Learning Analytics)

Core Functional Modules

Academic Operations

Course planning, automated clash-free timetable generator, configurable grading rubrics, exam scheduling, and automated report card printing.

Student & Staff SIS

Complete student lifecycle records, digital admissions, biometric/digital attendance logs, and staff payroll/leave tracking.

AI Insights Engine

Machine learning models detect learning pattern anomalies early, recommending targeted interventions and customized study plans.

Multi-Tenancy & Security

Isolated organizational tenancy ensuring FERPA and strict privacy compliance with granular role-based permissions.

fields.title: PrintNexx
fields.description: Internal image-processing and card-generation tool built to automate photo preparation, image finishing and ID card generation workflows.
fields.documentation:
Overview

PrintNexx is an internal production system in active daily use. It solves real-world bottlenecks in photo preparation, portrait aspect-ratio finishing, background segmentation, and mass ID card rendering.

Key Architectural Highlights

  • Automated Image Processing: OpenCV pipelines automatically detect faces, crop portraits to official ID ratios, and balance contrast.
  • Batch Finishing Workflow: Converts thousands of raw submissions into calibrated CMYK/RGB color profiles ready for industrial thermal card printers.
  • Zero-Downtime Operations: Packaged as a performant desktop and local server tool providing seamless daily throughput.

Technical Stack

Python, OpenCV, Image Processing, PIL, Automation Pipelines.
